title: Ananthu V/S Nusrath
desc: Ananthu, a lawyer from a traditional Brahmin family, falls for Nusrath, a judge from a different faith, leading to a heartfelt journey of love, family expectations and courtroom drama.

title: Shabdavedi
desc: A police officer turns to the people for help when his department refuses to fight crime and take down the dark world of narcotics.

title: Dhumm
desc: When Varada learns that his rival has killed his sister, he decides to avenge her death. He goes against the wishes of his mother who does not support his reckless methods.

title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.
